FILIPINO CATHOLICS CALLED TO PRAY AT THE SENATE

The Catholic Church in the Philippines, through the historic Radio Veritas, has called on the Catholic faithful to join the prayer vigil in front of the Philippines Senate building this June 9 to 11.

The Church is urging senators to start the impeachment proceedings against Sara Duterte as stated in the constitution for the sake of justice and unity.

Father Flavie Villanueva told Catholic radio that "there can be no truth when people start spreading lies," and that Filipinos can not allow violations of the constitution ik the form of the Senate derailing the trial.
